marta-partner-eng: quick heads-up — NexusCorp asked to move the sandbox -> shared-poc tenant next week. before we commit, we need a short checklist: data contract, entitlements, and any dedicated capacity pricing impact.
liam-se: thanks. are they expecting VPC peering or connector pull?
sasha-solution-arch: Nexus wants connector pull to avoid changing their firewall rules. we'll need an IP allowlist and egress plan.
nora-customer-eng: correct — we can run a connector. security asked whether logs contain raw PII.
sasha-solution-arch: logs should be redacted by default, but we need to confirm retention and KMS scope. i can paste the config snippet we plan to deploy: 
```
connector:
  mode: pull
  ip_allowlist: [54.23.12.5, 54.23.12.6]
  tls: enforced
  kms_scope: customer-key
  redact_patterns: [email, ssn]
```
marta-partner-eng: perfect. liam — pricing question: if they want 2 dedicated slots for the pilot (24/7), what's the delta vs hosted credits? need a rough number to share with partner sales.
liam-se: pilot commit (2x small-gpu) + networking = ~ $18k/mo estimate. i'll add buffer for peak. send me expected qps & avg seq len and i'll tighten.
nora-customer-eng: expected qps ~40 peak, avg seq 256 tokens.
liam-se: ok got it — will update pricing.
james-legal: quick flag — Nexus sent our standard security questionnaire with a data residency clause referencing EU-only storage and audit logs. do we support region-specific log routing for dedicated pilot?
sasha-solution-arch: yes, we can pin storage to eu-west for logs and blobs. for the control plane, they want minimal metadata retention; we'll propose 30d retention and an audit export.
marta-partner-eng: action items: 
- sasha: confirm connector cookbook + IP allowlist template (today)
- liam: send pilot pricing estimate + overage knobs (EOD)
- james: draft the reply to Nexus sec questionnaire re: retention & kms (tomorrow)
- nora: confirm whether connector agents can be installed on their jump box or they prefer our managed appliance (today)

nora-customer-eng: we prefer jump box install. will confirm path.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: shared-poc-connector-template v1.2 -> staging at 2023-11-14T18:00Z (no downtime).
marta-partner-eng: great — one more ask from partner: success criteria for cutover. suggest these three OKRs: 
1) avg 95th latency < 350ms for prompt->first-token
2) no PII in logs and SOC2 checklist signed
3) 2k daily successful requests within pilot week

liam-se: ack. i'll include latency SLO in the quote.
sasha-solution-arch: i'll assemble a 1-page runbook for cutover and rollback, including quick commands: 
```
# cutover
kubectl apply -f connector-deploy.yaml
# verify
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://shared-poc.redwood.example/healthz
```

marta-partner-eng: this is super helpful. i'll coordinate with partner AE to lock calendar once liam posts pricing. thanks everyone :rocket:
nora-customer-eng: thanks all, i'll update Nexus and come back with jump-box access window.
